stable.notes: Adds dedicated eight-frame walking loops for Nia Solari, Elara Vale and Rowan Vale, joining Miles Windu's existing walk. Nia also gets an eight-frame seated meditation loop while waiting. Distinct calm clips remain walking rests. The 32 new frames are registered to each character's existing scale. Native canary checks cover all four Jedi, speed controls, Reduced Motion and 16 retained stock upgrade histories. All previous idle/combat PNGs and Miles's 1.30x idle stay unchanged. Untouched stock packs upgrade automatically; custom art, timing, scale and saved preferences are preserved. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
